verses.2: What did you do to help the powerless ones, who have no strength to save their descendants?
verses.3: What advice did you give to someone who is not wise and intelligent at all?
verses.4: Who was it that you told about? And whose spirit came out of you?
verses.5: The doctors will be destroyed from beneath the water, and their homes will be destroyed as well.
verses.6: May the evil one be defeated, and may there be no harm to those who are lost.
verses.7: Noteh tsafon al-tohu tolei eretz al-bli-mama.
verses.8: A water conveyor, strong in its strength; no clouds will cover it below.
verses.9: He holds the face of the Ark above him.
verses.10: A holiday celebration on the face of the sea, until the light of the day comes again.
verses.11: The pillars of the sky will fall down, and they will be destroyed by their own violence.
verses.12: With his power, he divides the sea; and through his wisdom, he overcomes all obstacles.
verses.13: In the heavens, there was a loud noise; a snake’s hand was seen.
verses.14: These are the ends of his ways. What words are heard from him, and what a mighty noise comes from his actions! Who can endure it?
